p: that the reason the Sages forbade a cow's horn
is that "an accuser cannot become a defender,"
it is considered as if inside" —
that is, in the Kodesh HaKodashim,
the Kohen Gadol does enter in garments of gold.
"And wisdom — from where, ayin, is it found?":
from the place called Kodesh HaKodashim";
and it explains that the aspect of Ayin
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר חֵלֶק ב סד, ב).
and the Kodesh HaKodashim corresponds to Kesser Elyon.
Once I entered to offer the incense, etc.,
and I saw Achtariel Yah, Hashem Tzeva'os,
sitting upon a throne high and exalted."
is the name of Kesser Elyon,
for it contains the letters of "Kesser."
There is also proof from what he said,
"'Your throne is established from then' — az — etc.
The king stands upon the platform
Since You created Your world You are He,
but since You stood at the Sea
and we sang before You with 'Az,'
This is what they said in the holy Zohar
and shines to every side," etc.;
which is the aspect of the revelation of Atika.
Thus, with the revelation of the attribute of Atika,
שֶׁנִּקְרָא אָז ה׳ יוֹשֵׁב עַל כִּסֵּא.
so that Hashem is then called "sitting upon a throne."
and the Ancient of Days sat."
And the mitzvah is to hear the sound of the shofar
(רֹאשׁ, רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה פֶּרֶק ד סִימָן י;
for Hashem Yisbarach too is called
"Who hears the sound of the shofar and gives ear to the teruah"
in the text of the Shofaros blessing,
"And you shall walk in His ways";
to hear the sound of the shofar.
And Hashem Yisbarach sits upon the throne
where the attribute of Kesser Elyon is revealed;
and this is what they said in the Gemara cited above:
And as for its saying "since it is for remembrance" —
the intent follows what they said
"Shamor is in the heart and not in any other place" —
the aspect of "the mother of the children";
"remembering is in the male, in the brain," etc.,
"and therefore Zachor is for the male
וְהוּא עַל דֶּרֶךְ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
It is along the lines of what they said in the holy Zohar
"Zachor is a place that has no forgetting
and where forgetting has no place";
that is, the aspect of Atika;
in the Musaf of Rosh Hashanah, in the Zichronos blessing,
כִּי אֵין שִׁכְחָה לִפְנֵי כִּסֵּא כְבוֹדֶךָ,
"For there is no forgetting before Your throne of glory";
that is, "the Ancient of Days sat."
And this is the upper tip of the Yud,
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר חֵלֶק ג סה, ב);
and the letters Yud-Hei of the Name Havayah
there shines forth from Kesser Elyon into Chochmah.
And this is "Zachor — remembering is in the brain,"
into which there shines from Kesser Elyon
through the crownlet of the upper Yud.
And this is what they said:
"Since it is for remembrance, it is considered as if inside" —
that is, in the innermost Sanctum.
regarding the blood of the bull
that it is permitted for this reason:
"since it has changed, it has changed."
It is difficult: why did it not ask from the shofar,
but the sound of the shofar alone?
And that is a stronger case than the blood of the bull,
where something of the bull's body enters,
whereas here nothing at all enters
of the substance of the bull,
only the sound of the shofar.
But from this it is clear
that the sound of the shofar rises on high
וְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ שׁוֹמֵעַ מִשָּׁם הַקּוֹל שׁוֹפָר,
and Hashem Yisbarach hears the sound of the shofar from there;
rather, Hashem Yisbarach, as it were,
and as for Yisrael, at the time they blow,
the one blowing with the shofar is then
as if he had entered the Kodesh HaKodashim.
And this is what they said:
"Since it is for remembrance, it is considered as if inside" —
as though the one blowing were standing
and the shofar has not changed at all
מִכְּפִי מַה שֶּׁהָיָה עַל גּוּף הַפָּר,
from how it was on the body of the bull;
and because of this it is well understood
why the Sages forbade a cow's horn.
